text.tspan: B. Planning, history, presentation and setup
Same broker, BuildSim and occupancysim as panel A; these are not extra containers.
30 continuing containers = 10 sensors + 10 actuators + 10 shared services.
Plus seed: one-shot equipment registration and room roles.
History: until + max_age_s, ordered by simulated time.
Forecast h=5,10,15,20,25,30 sim-min; roll out u=0,1,2,3.
Choose lowest level with peak <900 ppm; if none qualifies, use level 3.
No booking/unavailable: persistence in deployed setup. Plans also carry heating.
Pipeline: bronze JSONL / silver Parquet; compaction every 300 s wall.
Archive bldg/# and sys/health/#; viewer replaces full layers/alerts.
Grafana 12.3.0 + Infinity 4.1.1. Control continues reactively if planning fails.
HTTP host ports 8090-8094 map to internal 8000; devices/seed publish no ports.
